llm_soc.sv.summary: Autonomous fixed-point graph. The parent owns host transactions, graph/operator states, operand routing, vector writes, scaling, softmax/value passes and token selection. Linear, head, QK-score and normalization engines have explicit interfaces; arithmetic and SRAM resources remain shared through parent muxes.

llm_math.sv.summary: Thirty-two S24 by S32 lanes use four structural byte multipliers per lane. Captured operands feed continuously clocked product/reduction stages. STREAMING=1 accepts every cycle while reset is released; STREAMING=0 admits one outstanding transaction. Relative to acceptance E0, product_valid is E3, sum_valid E8 and legacy done E9.

32 S56 values at E3"] P --> R["Registered reduction
S61 sum at E8"] V["Valid / ready control
STREAMING mode"] -.-> C & P & R V -.-> D["Legacy completion
Done at E9"]

llm_attention_engine.sv.summary: Issue ordered K-cache reads for positions zero through the current causal position. The parent captures Q/K operands and issues shared SIMD operations. Each sum is rounded by RNE16, narrowed to S39, structurally multiplied by 11585, then rounded by RNE16 and clamped to S32. The engine owns 128 scores and the running maximum; softmax and value accumulation stay in the parent.

S39 x 11585 to S55"] S --> T["Registered product
RNE16 and S32 clamp"] T --> A["128-entry score array
Maximum comparator / register"] A --> OUT["score_o / max_score_o / done_o
Parent softmax and V pass"]

llm_attention_normalize.sv.summary: Normalize 32 signed accumulators in batches of DIV_LANES. In llm_soc, DIV_LANES=4 and USE_SHARED=1: lane zero is wired to top u_div and lanes one through three instantiate private dividers. Quotient/remainder capture, RNE, sign restoration and S24 clamp occupy separate stages. Standalone USE_SHARED=0 instantiates all dividers internally.

flowchart TB A["32 signed S56 accumulators
Shared U32 denominator"] --> B["Batch operand capture
Magnitude U64 / sign bits"] B --> L["Lane 0 external u_div
USE_SHARED=1 in llm_soc"] B --> P["Lanes 1 to 3 private dividers
U64 numerator / U32 denominator"] L --> Q["Capture quotient and RNE decision"] P --> Q Q --> R["ROUND
Increment ties to even"] R --> S["SIGN
Restore original sign"] S --> C["CLAMP
S24 output lane registers"] C --> N["NEXT_BATCH
Eight batches at four lanes"] N -->|"More lanes"| B N --> O["vector_o 768 bits / done_o"]

ternary_dot32.sv.summary: Thirty-two signed S24 operands multiply ternary codes through S25 sign extension, zero selection and negation. Code 10 produces an aligned reserved flag. Four registered stages implement S25 terms, S28 octets, S29 halves and S30 sum; intervening pair/quad adders are combinational. Throughput is one transaction per cycle.
ternary_dot32.sv.graph:
flowchart TB X["32 S24 operands"] --> E["S25 sign extension"] W["32 U2 codes
01 plus / 11 minus / 00 zero"] --> T["Registered S25 terms"] E --> T T --> P["Combinational S26 pairs
Combinational S27 quads"] P --> O["Registered S28 octets"] O --> H["Registered S29 halves"] H --> S["Registered S30 sum_o"] W --> F["Code 10 detector
Four-stage reserved / valid pipeline"] F --> V["valid_o / reserved_o"]

isqrt_u64.sv.summary: Unsigned floor square root with 32 radix-four iterations. Append two radicand bits per step; one U35 subtractor supplies the trial remainder and borrow decision. Root and remainder feedback are explicit registers. start is accepted only when idle; busy/done frame the result.
isqrt_u64.sv.graph:
flowchart TB I["start / U64 radicand"] --> R["Radicand work register
Shift left by two per step"] R --> A["Append next two bits
U34 remainder_shift"] M["U34 remainder register"] --> A Q["U32 root register"] --> T["Trial: root shifted left two OR 1"] A --> S["U35 subtractor
Borrow selects acceptance"] T --> S S --> M S --> Q C["Controller / 32-step counter"] -.-> R C -.-> Q C -.-> M Q --> O["root U32 / busy / done"]

sram_word_tile.sv.summary: Replaceable portable SRAM behavior leaf with one synchronous read and one write. Nonblocking assignments preserve old data for same-edge same-address read/write. Storage and read payload have no reset or initialization.
sram_word_tile.sv.graph:
flowchart LR W["wr_en / wr_addr / wr_data"] --> M["WIDTH x ROWS memory array
No reset or initialization"] R["rd_en / rd_addr"] --> M M --> Q["Registered rd_data
Same-edge collision: old data"]

pipelined_word_ram.sv.summary: Replaceable SRAM adapter. USE_QUARTUS_MEMORY=1 selects 1024-word Quartus tiles when ROWS exceeds 4096, otherwise one whole-bank Quartus leaf. The portable branch uses 1024-word sram_word_tile leaves. Grouped responses preserve three-edge reads for up to four tiles and four-edge reads for larger banks. Writes commit one edge after capture; reset cancels queued enables and validity while preserving storage.

acc_mul.sv.summary: Parameterized combinational signed reduction. Sign-extend input terms, pad to a power of two and instantiate explicit generated adders. Current legacy ternary_mul uses four S9-to-S12 eight-input reductions and one S12-to-S14 four-input reduction; its S18 accumulator is outside acc_mul.
